$description: fomo campus tokens. fomo brand kit values come first; campus additions build on them and never override them. Grid and story templates share four colorways, one for each background the fomo kit allows.

blue.$description: fomo blue (campus purple). From the fomo brand kit: the default brand background and primary accent. Type and logos on it are white or #EAEDFF. The legacy blue token name remains for compatibility.

electric.$description: Electric blue. From the fomo brand kit: a small, high-energy accent or gradient depth. Never a background on its own.

highlight.$description: Light blue. From the fomo brand kit: soft glow or highlight only. Campus uses it to highlight one large word or figure on ink.

ink.$description: fomo ink. From the fomo brand kit: dark title cards and high-contrast compositions. Type and logos on it are white or #EAEDFF; it is also the dark type color on pale lavender and white.

pale.$description: Pale lavender. From the fomo brand kit: type on fomo blue and ink, and a light background. On it, type is fomo blue (large) or ink.

white.$description: White. From the fomo brand kit: type on fomo blue and ink, and a light background. On it, type is fomo blue (large) or ink.

action.$description: Action blue. Campus addition for the web only: links and solid buttons on light surfaces. Not used in graphics.

purple.$description: Campus purple: the campus name for fomo blue. Same color, same fomo rules.

family.$description: House default. Recent campaign use of Poppins ExtraBold is a campaign exception.

story.description: House safe-area guidance; interface overlays vary. Confirm the final preview in the destination app.

socialColorways.$description: One palette, two interchangeable formats. Grid posts and stories use the same four colorways, one for each background the fomo brand kit allows.
socialColorways.contrastRule: fomo pairings: white or #EAEDFF type and logos on campus purple (fomo blue) and ink; campus purple or ink on pale lavender and white. White on campus purple is 4.43:1, so keep small social copy at 32 px or more on a 1080 px canvas. On lavender and white, set small text in ink.

campaignAtmosphere.$description: Campus campaign surface: fomo's brand gradient, deepened toward electric blue in the lower corner. The fomo kit allows electric blue as gradient depth, never as its own background.
rules: Start from fomo's brand gradient: fomo blue with a large, diffuse light-blue glow in the upper third.
Electric blue may deepen the lower corner as gradient depth. It is never a background on its own.
Atmosphere belongs behind content. Keep the wordmark, eyes, and campus mark flat and unmodified.
Type stays white or #EAEDFF. Let scale, not color, carry emphasis on fomo blue.
On ink, light blue #ACB8F9 may highlight one large word or figure.

campaignRecipes.$description: Six reusable campaign patterns: the chapter series (Heating Up Chapters, Top Chapters, Fastest Onboards), two milestones, and a chapter invite. Each works as a grid post or a story in any of the four campaign colorways. Bracketed text is an editable placeholder, never a live count, promise, or verified fact.

heating-up-chapters.name: Heating Up Chapters
structure: Tracked eyebrow and the Heating Up Chapters title with a flame
Five rows: school logo, school name, chapter name, chapter logo
rules: Use only approved school and chapter logos, in their own colors.
Shorten long school names (Penn State, not Pennsylvania State University).
Keep five rows. Split a longer list across carousel slides instead of shrinking them.

top-chapters.name: Top Chapters
structure: Tracked eyebrow and the Top Chapters title with a crown
Five ranked rows: rank, school logo, school name, chapter name, count
rules: Rank only on confirmed numbers from one reporting period, and name the period in the caption.
Say what the count measures in the column label.
Only the leader gets the panel and the emphasis color.

fastest-onboards.name: Fastest Onboards
structure: Tracked eyebrow and the Fastest Onboards title with a bolt
Five rows: school logo, school name, chapter name, time to onboard
rules: Define “onboarded” the same way every week and use confirmed times only.
Keep one time format across the rows, such as 2h 14m.
List the fastest first; it gets the filled tag.

growth-milestone.name: Growth milestone
rules: Confirm the figure, its definition, and the reporting period before posting.
Keep the number and its label together.
Never reuse a past figure as a current fact.

chapter-milestone.name: Chapter milestone
rules: Confirm the total and what counts as a participating chapter.
Do not reshape the campus mark or the eyes into numerals.

chapter-invite.name: Chapter invite
structure: Reward and goal in one translucent panel
rules: Fill [rate] and [total] only with an approved offer. State eligibility and the required action beside it.
Use the colorway's emphasis color for the reward figures only.
Remove the reward panel when there is no approved offer.

campaignMotion.$description: Optional motion for milestone cards. The motion specimen in the brand kit follows these values.
campaignMotion.behavior: Hold the full headline, steps, CTA, logos, and figures still and readable for at least 3 seconds per loop. If motion is used, move or fade the background atmosphere gently during the remaining time without changing its color bounds or exceeding the 8% glow cap.
campaignMotion.contentRule: Do not cycle unverified figures, replace facts, or animate a reward into a promise. Avoid flashing, rapid zooms, and character-by-character reading barriers.
campaignMotion.reducedMotion: Provide the complete static poster with the same text and hierarchy. Use it whenever reduced motion is requested and as the fallback where animation is unavailable.
campaignMotion.stillFirst: A static export remains valid for all four recipes.

campaignColorways.$description: Every campaign pattern is available in the same four colorways as the social templates, one for each background the fomo brand kit allows. display is for large type, emphasis for the one focal figure, and text for everything below display size.

purple.name: Purple
purple.description: fomo brand gradient with electric depth · white type, mark, and emphasis

lavender.name: Lavender
lavender.description: Lavender field with a white glow · ink type and mark · purple emphasis

ink.name: Ink
ink.description: fomo technical gradient · white type and mark · light blue highlight

white.name: White
white.description: White field with a lavender halo · ink type · purple mark and emphasis

officialGradients.$description: From the fomo brand kit: a soft blue spotlight over a solid field. Atmospheric, never shiny or multicoloured. Type white or #EAEDFF.

brand.placement: Large, diffuse glow in the upper third, faded to transparent.
brand.use: Title cards, covers, launch graphics, social backgrounds.

technicalPremium.placement: Large, diffuse halo top-centre, faded to transparent.
